description: Runs the destination-charge blueprint against the Dockerized Hive marketplace fixture and scores whether sellers are integrated as Connect recipients.

expected_patterns.description: Python Stripe SDK is declared in backend requirements
backend supports seller onboarding for Connect accounts
Checkout or payment flow uses a Connect destination/application fee
Connect state is tied to the existing seller model
backend handles relevant Connect/payment webhook events

forbidden_patterns.description: workspace does not contain hardcoded Stripe API keys
backend does not pass raw card numbers to Stripe

command_checks.name: hive marketplace docker config
command_checks.command: if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose config >/dev/null; else docker-compose config >/dev/null; fi
